people.name: Bernard Edwards
people.extract: Bernard Edwards was an American bassist known primarily for his work in disco with guitarist Nile Rodgers, with whom he co-founded Chic. In 2017, Edwards was selected as the 53rd greatest bassist of all time by Bass Player magazine.
highlights: Co-founded disco band Chic with Nile Rodgers.
Known for his influential bass work in disco.
Ranked 53rd greatest bassist by Bass Player magazine.

people.name: Alonso Núñez de Haro y Peralta
people.extract: Dr. Alonso Núñez de Haro y Peralta was archbishop of Mexico from September 12, 1772, to May 26, 1800, and viceroy of New Spain from May 8, 1787, to August 16, 1787.
highlights: Served as Viceroy of New Spain in 1787.

people.name: Ethel Waters
people.extract: Ethel Waters was an American singer and actress. Waters frequently performed jazz, swing, and pop music on the Broadway stage and in concerts. She began her career in the 1920s singing blues. Her notable recordings include "Dinah", "Stormy Weather", "Taking a Chance on Love", "Chlo-e, "Heat Wave", "Supper Time", "Am I Blue?", "Birmingham Bertha", "Cabin in the Sky", "I'm Coming Virginia", and her version of "His Eye Is on the Sparrow". Waters was the second African American to be nominated for an Academy Award, the first African American to star on her own television show, and the first African-American woman to be nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award.
highlights: Second African American nominated for an Academy Award.
First African American to star on her own TV show.
First African-American woman nominated for a Primetime Emmy.
